dis.h: personal firm resolve, like a pledge

p.n: 결정 is just choosing; 결심 adds firm personal determination.

examples.en: I was tired, so my shoulders drooped.
Skin sags as you get older.

explain: 위에서 아래로 늘어지거나 기운이 없어지는 것이에요. '어깨가 처지다', '축 처지다'처럼 써요.
explain_en: To hang down, or to lose energy. Used as '어깨가 처지다' or '축 처지다'.

examples.en: This place serves authentic Italian food.
I made kimchi the traditional way.

explain: 한 분야에서 바르게 이어져 온 전통이나 계통이에요. '정통 한식'처럼 명사 앞에 써서 '진짜 방식의'라는 뜻을 더해요.

phrases.en: This restaurant serves authentic Korean food.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전통 방식 그대로의 한국 음식을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for Korean food made in the traditional way.

phrases.nuance_ko: 음악에서 원래 방식을 지키는 스타일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In music, it describes a style that keeps to the original form.

phrases.en: This bread is made in the authentic way.
phrases.nuance_ko: '정통 방식으로'는 원래 전통대로 만든다는 뜻으로, 만드는 방법을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '정통 방식으로' means doing something in the original, traditional way, often used for how something is made.

explain_en: The proper, traditional line of something. Placed before a noun, as in '정통 한식', it means 'authentic'.

examples.en: The whole family went on a trip together.
It snowed, so the whole world is white.

explain: '전체의, 모든'이라는 뜻으로 명사 바로 앞에 써요. '온 가족', '온 세상', '온 힘'처럼 몇 개의 말과 주로 써요.
explain_en: Means 'whole' or 'all' and goes directly before a noun. Mostly used in set combinations like '온 가족', '온 세상' and '온 힘'.

examples.en: You have to check in your baggage first.
The baggage screening area is over there.

explain: 비행기를 탈 때 부치거나 들고 타는 짐이에요. 표준 표기는 '수하물'이고 '수화물'은 틀린 표기예요.
explain_en: Bags you check in or carry on when flying. The correct spelling is '수하물'; '수화물' is a misspelling.

examples.en: I waited for a long time.
I met an old friend.

explain: 시간이 길고 오랜 것을 말해요. 대부분 '오랜 시간', '오랜만'처럼 관형형 '오랜'으로 써요.
explain_en: Describes time that is long. It mostly appears in the form '오랜', as in '오랜 시간' or '오랜만'.

dis.h: long in time only; for ages

p.n: 긴 simply says the time was long; 오랜 feels like a very long while.

en: to play a game (e.g., baduk) against each other

examples.en: Yesterday I played a game of baduk with a friend.

examples.ko: 그 선수는 내일 세계 챔피언과 대국해요.
examples.en: That player plays the world champion tomorrow.

explain: 바둑이나 장기를 두 사람이 마주 앉아 겨루는 것이에요. '~와/과 대국하다'로 써요.

phrases.en: The two players are in the middle of a game right now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 경기를 하고 있는 중이라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to say a game is in progress right now.
phrases.en_equiv: to be in the middle of a game

phrases.nuance_ko: 대국의 결과를 말할 때 '이기다, 지다'와 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Pair with '이기다' or '지다' to talk about the result of a game.

phrases.en: A big baduk match will be held tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사로 써서 바둑 경기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used as a noun to refer to a baduk match.

explain_en: To face an opponent in a game like baduk or janggi. Used as '~와/과 대국하다'.

examples.en: I'm very interested in art.
That person has an artistic sense.

explain: 음악, 미술, 문학처럼 아름다움을 표현하는 활동이에요. '예술가', '예술적'처럼 다른 말과 붙여 많이 써요.
explain_en: Activities that express beauty, such as music, painting and literature. Often combined as '예술가' or '예술적'.

examples.en: Stop drinking coffee now.
It's late. Let's stop for today.

explain: 하던 일을 더 하지 않고 멈추는 뜻이에요. '그만 먹어요', '그만하세요'처럼 동사 앞에 써요.
explain_en: Means stopping what you were doing. Used before a verb, as in '그만 먹어요' or '그만하세요'.

examples.en: A fairy appears in the fairy tale.

examples.ko: 우리 반 날씨 요정 덕분에 오늘도 소풍을 갔어요.
examples.en: Thanks to our class's weather fairy, we went on the picnic today too.

explain: 이야기에 나오는 작고 신비한 존재예요. '날씨 요정'처럼 어떤 일에 운이 좋은 사람을 귀엽게 부르기도 해요.

phrases.en: weather fairy (someone with good weather luck)
phrases.en_equiv: weather fairy (someone with good weather luck)

explain_en: A small magical being from stories. It can also be a cute nickname for someone who is lucky at something, as in '날씨 요정'.

examples.en: I like long-distance running.
Driving long distances is tiring.

explain: 먼 거리를 말해요. '장거리 달리기', '장거리 운전'처럼 써요. 반대말은 '단거리'예요.
explain_en: A long distance. Used as '장거리 달리기' or '장거리 운전'. The opposite is '단거리'.

examples.en: We took photos at the studio.
I live in a studio apartment.

explain: 사진, 음악, 방송을 만드는 방이에요. 방 한 칸짜리 작은 집도 '스튜디오 아파트'라고 해요.

phrases.en: I sang a song at the recording studio.
phrases.nuance_ko: '스튜디오' 앞에 '녹음'을 붙여 음악이나 목소리를 녹음하는 방을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '녹음' (recording) before 'studio' refers to a room where music or voices are recorded.

phrases.en: We took a family photo at the photo studio.
phrases.nuance_ko: '스튜디오'만 말할 때보다 사진을 찍는 곳이라는 뜻이 분명해져요.
phrases.nuance_en: This makes it clearer than just '스튜디오' that it is a place for taking photos.

phrases.en: I'm going to the studio tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조사 '에'와 동사 '가다'를 붙여 스튜디오로 이동한다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding the particle '에' and the verb '가다' expresses going to a studio.

explain_en: A room for making photos, music or broadcasts. A one-room apartment is also called a '스튜디오 아파트'.

examples.en: I'll ask the manager first.
That singer's manager is very busy.

explain: 가게나 팀, 연예인의 일을 관리하는 사람이에요. '이벤트 매니저', '가게 매니저'처럼 앞에 분야를 붙여요.
explain_en: A person who manages a shop, a team or a celebrity's schedule. Add the field before it, as in '이벤트 매니저'.
